public_holidays: 2027-01-20 (Wednesday): Dia do Católico, state holiday (Lei 3.137/2016); the state may move the observance (Lei 2.126/2009), as it did in 2026 from 20 to 22 January
2027-03-08 (Monday): Dia Internacional da Mulher, state holiday (Lei 1.411/2001)
2027-06-15 (Tuesday): Aniversário do Estado do Acre, state holiday (Lei 14/1964)
2027-09-05 (Sunday): Dia da Amazônia, state holiday (Lei 243/1968); it falls on a Sunday in 2027
culture-cycles.note: The state sets other optional days (pontos facultativos, such as Carnival) by a yearly decree for its own offices; the 2027 decree is not yet published. Municipal holidays are not covered here.
